absent: Termios layout and baud encoding beyond delegation to current settings.
Flip insertion internals, deferred work scheduling and buffer growth or reclaim policy.
Driver lookup, open, hangup, shutdown and removal ordering with error handling.
Discipline selection, switching and cross thread synchronization.
Port activation, carrier handling, transmit draining and close timing effects.
Virtio feature negotiation order, queue setup and transport specific behavior.
Shared memory discovery, admin command sequencing and mapping error handling.

findings.text: Staging element for incoming bytes holds queue linkage that shares storage with a free list node, plus separate counters for live bytes, capacity, committed prefix, speculative peek position and consumed prefix, a small state flag, and a trailing payload area aligned for word access.

Queue head for flip path tracks head and tail of active chain, a workqueue and deferred work item for delivery, a mutex for mutation, an atomic priority, an embedded sentinel node, a lock free pool of reusable elements, plus atomic accounting of memory in use with a limit that does not count pooled elements.

Driver operation vector groups lifecycle, transfer and control duties. Lifecycle covers lookup, binding, teardown, open and close. Transfer covers block write, single character emit, kick, space query and backlog query. Control covers settings, flow pause and resume, output pause and resume, hangup, break, flush, discipline checks, drain wait, priority character, modem query and update, geometry, statistics, serial parameters, fd display, plus optional poll and proc hooks.

Driver record carries reference management, character device slots, owner, driver and node naming with base and numeric range, instance count, family and variant classification, default terminal settings, capability word, proc linkage, peer for paired drivers, shared flip queue, per index tables for terminals ports and settings, opaque state, operation vector and global list node.

Discipline interface separates calls arriving from above and events arriving from below. From above it supports open, close, flush, file oriented transfer, control, settings, readiness and hangup. From below it supports delivery of bytes with marks, an alternate sized delivery, non consuming peek, transmit wakeup and carrier notification. Binding record pairs the operation vector with its terminal.

Discipline semaphore record holds an atomic state word, a low level spin guard for waiter handling, a count of waiting readers and distinct queues for read versus write waiters, with optional dependency tracking.

Port record combines flip buffering with current and alternate terminal pointers, hardware control vector and client receive vector, a spin guard, open counters including blocked attempts, waits for open and modem change, status and input flag words, a single bit console mark, two mutexes for lifetime versus buffer paths, linear and fifo transmit storage, close timing values, a reference count and opaque client data. Hardware vector handles carrier, modem signals, shutdown, activation and destruction. Client vector handles sized receive, peek and wakeup.

Queue record links into its device, carries a completion callback, a name, a back link, an index, counts of free and maximum descriptors, a reset indicator and private data. Device record carries an index, failure and configuration flags, two spin guards, a generic device, an identifier, transport and auxiliary operation vectors, a queue list, feature storage, private data and a mapping choice. Driver record carries a generic driver, identifier and feature tables with lengths plus legacy variants, and hooks for validation, probe, scan, removal, configuration change, suspend, resume, reset phases and shutdown.

Transport vector abstracts configuration reads and writes with generation and status handling, device reset, queue creation and removal with callback barrier, feature discovery and confirmation, bus naming, affinity management, shared region lookup and queue reset sequencing. Mapping vector abstracts page mapping with unmap, processor and device synchronization, coherent allocation and release, plus checks for sync need, mapping failure and maximum extent.

Auxiliary virtio records include a mapping choice between DMA device and queue group, a shared region extent of address and length, a queue request of name callback and context flag, an admin envelope with opcode group identity scatter lists completion result length and status, a legacy PCI anchor with interrupt status and config mappings plus identifier, and a DMA buffer extension with attach and identifier query.
Receive mark for normal data is zero, break is one, framing error is two, parity error is three and overrun is four.

Capability word assigns bit zero to installed, one to termios reset, two to raw mode, three to dynamic device, four to devpts memory, five to hardware break, six to dynamic allocation, seven to unnumbered node, eight to workqueue suppression and nine to saved termios reset. Family selects among system, console, serial, pty, scc and syscons. Variant numbering starts at one with system flavors for tty console syscons and ptmx, pty flavors for master and slave, and serial normal.
Initialized is bit zero, suspended is bit one, active is bit two, hardware flow is bit three, carrier detection is bit four and kernel exclusive open is bit five.
Feature set spans two words for one hundred twenty eight bits, declared as a union exposing both scalar and array views.

Flip head mutex guards queue linkage and active pointers while priority and memory counters use atomics. Port spin guard protects fast state, one mutex protects lifetime and open path and another protects buffer path, with waits for open completion and modem change. Discipline semaphore spin guard protects waiter queues. Device configuration spin guard protects status and change flags while queue list spin guard protects membership.

Total users is the sum of open count and blocked open count. Individual status queries and updates act on single bits inside the input flag word for flow, active, carrier, suspended and kernel opened states. Linking to a driver queue only applies when the port currently lacks a queue.

Shared region lookup returns false without invoking anything when the transport lacks support. Feature gated read checks negotiation first and reports absence for missing bits, otherwise performs a little endian configuration read. Sized configuration writes convert from processor order to device order and may sleep before invoking transport set.
Each header in this lane defines a single inclusion guard macro that prevents repeated processing.

Initialization binds a fresh static dependency key to the semaphore through an inner helper. Nested read and write acquisition forms ignore subclass and forward to the plain forms with the same timeout.

Conversion helpers select width specific handling by static type, covering one two four and eight byte forms, with a type derivation helper that infers native type from a member access. Structured configuration write derives a device order temporary from a native value, sanity checks its type and issues a sized transport set at the member offset.

Baud query derives speed from current terminal settings. Discipline initializer, audit exit and fork hooks, proc driver hooks and virtio debug hooks do nothing in this build, while audit push reports success.

Flip string insertion forwards characters, marks and length to a common inserter with copying enabled. Driver reference helper increments its count and returns the same object. Port terminal guard constructor acquires a referenced terminal for scoped lifetime. Memory access callback setter either stores the supplied predicate or compiles to nothing depending on build variant.

Virtio driver declaration expands to paired registration and unregistration through the generic driver helper. Discipline alias expands to a string that prefixes the numeric identifier with a fixed bus tag.

Port conditions for initialized, active, suspended and kernel exclusive open are independent bits rather than a single enum, with flow control and carrier detection as orthogonal enables. Queue reset is signaled by a boolean that separates steady operation from a disable then enable sequence supplied by the transport.

Peek position is updated lazily on receive and can lag behind consumed position, so ordering assumptions between them are unsafe. Memory limit accounting omits pooled free elements, so cached empties can exceed the apparent bound. Queue linkage and free list linkage share storage, so an element cannot be on both lists at once.
